versions.changelog:
- Initial release of grocery-price-book: a modern personal grocery price book tool.
- Log purchases manually or import receipts to build a price history in a local JSON file.
- Compares unit prices across sizes and stores, detects shrinkflation, and tracks price changes.
- Ranks stores based on your actual shopping basket, not generic averages.
- Includes tools to analyze bulk-buy and membership breakeven scenarios.
- No cloud or account required; all processing is local and privacy-friendly.
